sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a touch of playful elegance to your jewelry rotation with our Beaded Bow Necklace. This piece features a unique gold-toned beaded chain paired with a beautifully sculpted ribbon pendant, making it the perfect fashion-forward accessory for everyday charm. To ensure this delicate piece keeps its radiant glow for all your special moments, we recommend keeping it tucked away in a dry place after use and avoiding contact with perfumes and moisture.
